caption:
What are the best aesthetic treatments for your 30s? Age alone cannot answer that.

People of the same age can have different concerns, anatomy, skin behavior, sun exposure, facial movement, weight changes, habits, and hormonal shifts. A personalized treatment plan should start with the change you notice—not the decade on your ID.

Name what changed, when it appears, and which outcome matters to you. Send this to the friend shopping for treatments by birthday.

General education only.

#SkinAging #AestheticTreatments #PersonalizedTreatment #AestheticMedicine #KoreanAesthetics
first_comment: What made you first think about treatment — something you actually noticed in the mirror, or a birthday? I ask this in almost every consultation, and the answer changes the plan.

slides.alt_text: Slide 1 of 6: Three women of the same age photographed side by side. Title: What is best for your 30s?
Slide 2 of 6: Three outlined circles labelled pigment, movement lines and volume change. One age, three priorities.
Slide 3 of 6: Seven blocks: sun, genetics, movement, skin quality, weight change, habits, and hormonal shifts.
Slide 4 of 6: Same age leads to different concerns, priorities and plans. Age-based menus are a marketing shortcut.
Slide 5 of 6: Three numbered prompts: what do you notice, does it show at rest or in motion, which outcome matters.
Slide 6 of 6: Problem, priority, plan — what changed, what matters most, what fits now. Treat the face, not the decade.
